This remote role provides administrative and coordination support across professional membership, education, continuing education, and major professional events.

You will help keep recurring workflows, schedules, communications, reporting, and program requirements organized and on track.

The position works closely with internal teams, healthcare professionals, volunteers, vendors, and other stakeholders.

It offers an opportunity to contribute to programs that support healthcare professionals and advance professional education.

Success in the role requires strong organization, accuracy, responsiveness, and the ability to manage competing priorities.

You will also support digital events, customer service activities, content workflows, and continuing education processes.

This is a collaborative, deadline-driven environment suited to a resourceful coordinator who enjoys varied responsibilities.

Accountabilities

Coordinate administrative activities across professional membership, professional education, continuing education, and annual conference initiatives.
Manage scheduling for meetings, podcast recordings, and other activities involving healthcare professionals with complex calendars.
Prepare and coordinate monthly team reporting and maintain accurate program information and records.
Coordinate content calendars and publishing activities for professional social media channels.
Monitor and respond to customer service inquiries through Salesforce and ensure requests are handled appropriately.
Support timelines, administrative processes, and coordination requirements for the annual professional conference.
Process vendor payments, volunteer reimbursements, and other financial administration activities.
Collect required continuing education speaker documentation and maintain accurate faculty and program rosters.
Support the dissemination and tracking of continuing education peer-review activities.
Build and maintain monthly continuing education activities within the designated professional education resource center.
Provide editorial workflow and administrative support for professional publications.
Provide technical coordination and support for virtual events, including educational sessions, podcast recordings, and member calls.
Take on additional administrative and program coordination responsibilities as needed while maintaining professionalism, accuracy, and confidentiality.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university preferred.
2–3 years of relevant office or administrative experience preferred, ideally including experience supporting healthcare professionals.
Experience in project coordination or program management is desirable.
Advanced organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, recurring workflows, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when managing data, schedules, documentation, and administrative processes.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with a customer-service-oriented approach.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, word processing tools, and Outlook Calendar.
Ability to work independently, establish priorities, manage deadlines, and remain effective under time pressure.
Resourceful and collaborative approach, with the ability to contribute effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Professionalism, discretion, integrity, and sound judgment when handling sensitive information and stakeholder interactions.
Comfortable providing technical support for virtual meetings and digital events.
Willingness to travel approximately once annually, including occasional overnight travel if required.

Remote work: U.S.-based remote position with flexibility.
Paid time off: Vacation, sick leave, and holidays.
Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Retirement: 403(b) retirement plan with matching contributions.
Financial support: Flexible spending accounts for eligible healthcare and dependent-care expenses.
Insurance: Life insurance coverage.
Employee support: Access to confidential counseling and resources through an Employee Assistance Program.
Commuter benefits: Support for eligible transit and parking expenses.
Referral program: Opportunities to earn rewards for successful employee referrals.
Inclusive culture: A collaborative workplace focused on diversity, respect, inclusion, and professional growth.

jobs.description:
Marketing Statement

Woodhull Medical and Mental Health Center is attuned to the healthcare issues that matter to the people of North Brooklyn. Woodhull focuses on preventing disease and promoting healthy lifestyles by reaching out to the community at various convenient locations.

At NYC Health + Hospitals, our mission is to deliver high-quality care health services, without exception. Every employee takes a person-centered approach that exemplifies the ICARE values (Integrity, Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence) through empathic communication and partnerships between all persons.

Duties & Responsibilities

Purpose of Position
:

This class of positions encompasses professional, supervisory or administrative work of varying degrees of difficulty and responsibility in the operation of a social work department providing psychosocial and other social work services to different types of patients across various settings. Ensures patient-centered quality care and services in support of better outcomes and improved patient experience, in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal rules and regulations, and social work standards of care. All personnel perform related work.

Under general supervision, with some latitude for the exercise of independent judgment, performs the following:

Examples Of Typical Tasks

With or without supervision, based upon licensure, performs the typical tasks described in Assignment Level I at a higher level:

Screens charts for historical and clinical information, conducts psychosocial evaluations through interviews with patients and/or identified surrogates and formulates appropriate social work treatment plans.
Works within health care setting offices or in community settings within NYC to provide individual and group counseling, as well as concrete social services, as required.
Confers and consults with professionals in other disciplines to determine and implement a multidisciplinary approach to patient care and to develop treatment plans, evaluate patients’ progress, develop discharge and aftercare plans and recommend alternative action or treatment.
Provides outreach services, makes referrals to other governmental, public and/or community agencies, prepares patients to accept services, provides direct social work services on high-risk cases and may escort patients in connection with community activities and referrals, as needed.
As a mandated reporter, documents and reports suspected cases of child abuse or neglect to the New York State Central Registry.
Appears and testifies at administrative and court hearings, as necessary.
Assists in plans for institutional or hospital discharge and other post institutional/hospital care; evaluates alternate care arrangements for patients, where needed.
Participates in staff conferences and other related social work meetings, special studies, committees and/or research projects and internal/external quality assurance/performance improvement (QA/PI) activities, programs, and trainings, as required.
Prepares reports and related paperwork; keeps appropriate records.
Ensures ongoing compliance with NYC Health + Hospitals policies and procedures with national standards and other applicable external regulatory requirements, guidelines, and accreditation authorities, as well as safety and quality management standards.
May assist in the provision of clinical services only under supervision of a New York State LCSW, licensed psychologist, or psychiatrist.
Performs other related duties, as directed and with required supervision.

In Addition To Performing The Typical Tasks Described In Assignment Level I Above With Or Without Supervision Based Upon Licensure And At a Higher Level, Performs The Following Typical Tasks

Mentors and assists less experienced social work staff in social work techniques and serves as a resource in various aspects of advanced social work practice.
May supervise graduate and undergraduate social work students, as well as volunteers and other auxiliary personnel, as needed.
May assist in the provision of clinical services only under supervision of a New York State LCSW, licensed psychologist, or psychiatrist or perform such functions independently as a LCSW.

Minimum Qualifications

For Assignment to Level II

Valid license as an LMSW issued by the NYSED; or
Valid license as an LCSW issued by the NYSED.

The Customer Program Manager drives the seamless execution of managed and professional services from proposal through implementation, ensuring alignment with business objectives and fulfilling customer needs. Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas

Lead the end-to-end delivery of managed and professional services, from planning through implementation to operational handover, ensuring execution is on time, within budget, and aligned with contractual obligations and SES standards.
Steer customer programs in line with defined governance and project excellence standards, ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery across the full service lifecycle.
Own program planning, execution, and reporting, providing accurate and timely updates on progress, KPIs, risks, and recovery actions to senior management.
Ensure SES implements services based on customer service level agreement/contract and our standard concept of operations.
Act as the primary customer interface during implementation, building strong relationships, managing expectations, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
Act as an escalation point for issues with existing processes that live in other departments such as Network Engineering, Network Operations, Finance, Sales, and Legal, during implementation of a service or changes to an existing service.
Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, and dependencies, driving mitigation actions and coordinating cross-functional resolution and escalation where required.
Drive financial performance of programs, including budget management, cost control, and contribution to customer profitability.
Continuously monitor program performance and customer feedback, using insights to drive service improvements, customer retention, and operational efficiency.
Serve as a subject matter expert and lead on complex or strategic programs, contributing to business-critical initiatives.
Recommend and influence enhancements to processes, policies, technologies, and services to improve delivery effectiveness and support organizational objectives.
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, operational execution, and business objectives.

COMPETENCIES

Customer-Centric Leadership & Stakeholder Influence: Drive programs with a strong focus on customer needs and value delivery, building trusted relationships and communicating effectively across all levels, including senior stakeholders, to ensure alignment and long-term partnership success.
Operational Excellence & Project Delivery Discipline: Lead programs with rigor and consistency, ensuring high-quality execution against scope, schedule, cost, SLAs, and KPIs, while continuously improving delivery processes, efficiency, and scalability.
Strategic Program Leadership & Integration: Orchestrate complex, cross-functional programs by integrating multiple workstreams into cohesive execution, aligning service delivery with customer requirements and broader business objectives.
Financial & Business Acumen: Drive strong financial performance through budget ownership, forecasting, cost control, and an understanding of market dynamics, industry trends, and competitive landscape.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Organizational Impact: Break down silos and foster collaboration across engineering, operations, and commercial teams, ensuring shared accountability and seamless service delivery in a global, matrixed environment.
Innovation, Continuous Improvement & Change Leadership: Promote innovation and drive continuous improvement in service delivery, enabling adoption of new products, technologies, and processes while leading teams through transformation.
Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Apply strong analytical, strategic, and solution-oriented thinking to solve complex challenges, identify root causes, and develop pragmatic, high-impact solutions.
High-Performance Team Leadership: Inspire and guide teams in a matrix organization, fostering accountability, engagement, and resilience while maintaining focus and performance in dynamic, high-pressure environments.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of ten (10) years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
Proven track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder customer programs end-to-end, delivering against scope, schedule, budget, SLAs, and KPIs while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
Demonstrated leadership capability, including influencing and driving outcomes in a matrixed organization without direct authority.
Proven ability to manage program scope, change control, risk, and resource planning while proactively identifying and mitigating potential impacts.
Strong business and financial acumen with advanced skills in decision-making, negotiation, and executive-level presentations.
Experience leading the delivery of complex technology programs and services, preferably within telecommunications or managed services environments.
Track record of managing programs against service-level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Experience executing contractual deliverables and ensuring compliance with agreed terms, timelines, and customer expectations.
Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments while managing competing priorities and evolving requirements.
Technical knowledge in one or more relevant domains (e.g., managed services such as media, broadband or mobility, satellite communications, or telecommunications service provider environments).
C1 proficiency in English is required; proficiency in French is preferred.

Advanced degree or post graduate training
Project Management certification (Prince2, PMI-PMP, etc…)
